newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF to seek 40,000T soymeal on Friday.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF to seek 40,000T soymeal on Friday.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) said on Wednesday it will re-invite tenders to buy 40,000 tonnes of soymeal by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Friday.
An official at the federation said arrival for the soymeal tender was set by September 30 or October 20 to the ports of Inchon, Kunsan and Ulsan.
Shipment for arrival by September 30 was set for August 25-September 13, if sourced from India or July 28-August 16, if from South America.
Shipment for arrival by October 20 was set for September 14-October 3, if from India or August 17-September 5, if from South America.
On Tuesday, the official said the federation had passed on the tender due to higher-than-expected prices.
